=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-pro-preview ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:Line or code reference: sanitized_push_probe_output="$(printf '%s' "${push_probe_output}" | sed -E ...)" | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The push probe output sanitization logic only redacts credentials but fails to defang GitHub Actions workflow commands (like `::error::` or `##[error]`) from the untracked git output before echoing it to stdout.
  WHY: Since `git push --dry-run` echoes server-side output which may contain coincidentally formatted or malicious workflow commands, echoing this output without defanging will trick the Actions runner into interpreting them as real workflow annotations, leading to spurious build failures or command injection.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:Line or code reference: test_known_ci_artifacts_removed_in_resolve_step() | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test asserts that the `'rm -f scripts/ai_memory.py...'` string occurs at least once in `review_autofix.yml` to verify that the resolver step cleans up artifacts.
  WHY: Because the exact same `'rm -f'` line is present earlier in the workflow inside the Detect merge conflicts step, the total count in the file will be 1 or greater even if the target cleanup logic is entirely removed from the resolver script (`scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh`). This allows the resolver cleanup logic to be deleted while the CI test trivially passes, masking a regression.
- agents.md:Line or code reference: "- Missing log-archive soft-fail normalization (scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py)..." | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new environment variable bullet was inserted into the middle of the `<!-- anchor:agents-env-vars -->` list instead of at the bottom.
  WHY: The anchor block carries an explicit mandate to append new env-var bullets to the bottom of this list under this anchor, and to not reorder existing bullets. Inserting bullets in the middle of the block violates this contract and triggers systemic git merge conflicts when multiple parallel orchestrator waves attempt to modify the agent instructions simultaneously.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-pro-preview ===
